local_context.value: Oldest city in Polk County (incorporated 1885), elevation 144 ft, flat with gently rolling hills; 5,100 people (2020); Fort Meade Historic District. Median year built 1974 from an aggregator (not official).

neighborhoods.value: PARTIAL, Redfin listings only (not official): Downtown Fort Meade, Stoneybrook Golf and Country Club. Fewer than 3, so the section is dropped.

place_entities.value: 1) Patterson Park. 2) Fort Meade Outdoor Recreation Area. 3) Old Fort Meade School House Museum. 4) Christ Church (Episcopal, 1889; used in the 1990 HBO film Judgment). Also Fort Meade Public Library, 75 East Broadway.

permit_office.value: City of Fort Meade, PO Box 856, (863) 285-1119, https://www.cityoffortmeade.org/. Issuing department unconfirmed (shed-vendor pages say city hall); no official permit page found.
